run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T00:14:38Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend-proxy is corroborated: frontend-proxy's own ERROR-status spans jumped from ~3.2 per 10m before the burst to ~175 per 10m in the 10-minute windows ending 00:19-00:25, and they were concentrated in its own 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' spans. The error chain is confined to the checkout path: frontend spans for POST /api/checkout, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder carried ~85 errors per 10m, and checkout spans for oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and its client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carried ~43 per 10m; other services showed 0 or ~1 error span in the same 15m window, and the same 10m error increase for frontend and frontend-proxy was 0 in the pre-incident window 23:45-23:55. The deepest entity on that chain is payment, which was rollout-restarted at 00:14:51 with an unchanged pod template (only kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt was added; image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment and env identical to the revision-1 ReplicaSet): the old pod payment-55766d76b9-5frt4 was killed at 00:14:56 and the new pod payment-79d86bf97f-9pm9t logged its gRPC server start only at 00:16:12.791, with no charge traffic logged before that. In otel-demo the only object holding fault-injection settings is ConfigMap flagd-config, whose paymentFailure flag is set to '100%' and paymentUnreachable to 'on' (all other flags 'off'); flagd mounts that ConfigMap and frontend, checkout and payment all point at flagd:8013. Following the guidance that a restart with an unchanged pod template is a mechanism, not the cause, the fault settings in flagd-config are the leading candidate for root cause, with the payment restart and the resulting checkout/payment-charge failures as mechanism and consequence. However this remains partial: payment's own spans record no error status and it resumed serving charges while both flags are still on and the errors stopped, the injected fault itself was never observed firing, and the time of the flag change cannot be established, so restart-induced payment unavailability is also reported as an unresolved alternative.

claims.text: frontend-proxy's own error spans rose from ~3.16 per 10m status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR before 00:16 to 175.69 per 10m at the 10-minute window ending 00:19 and stayed ~172-177 per 10m through the window ending 00:25, while its STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans stayed ~12.5k-13.0k per 10m in the same windows.

frontend-proxy's error spans are its own span names 'ingress' (89.47 per 10m in the window ending 00:20, 90.53 ending 00:22, 89.47 ending 00:24, 43.16 ending 00:26, 4.26 ending 00:28) and 'router frontend egress' (85.26 per 10m in the windows ending 00:20-00:24, then 40 ending 00:26 and 0 from 00:28).

frontend's own error spans are on span names 'POST /api/checkout', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder', each 84.21 per 10m in the window ending 00:18, ~86 and 85.26 in the windows ending 00:21 and 00:24, 1.06 in the window ending 00:27 and 0 from the window ending 00:30; its GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data and cart/currency/ad client spans show 0 errors.

checkout's own error spans are on 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and its client span 'oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge', both 42.81 per 10m in the window ending 00:24 and 1.06 in the window ending 00:27, 0 by 00:30; over the 10 minutes ending 00:17:42 checkout had 131.76 error spans.

In the pre-incident window 23:45-23:55 the 10-minute error-span increase was 0 for frontend and 0 for frontend-proxy, so the burst was new rather than background (no checkout error series was returned for that instant, so checkout's pre-incident level is unknown).

In the 15 minutes ending 00:25 error spans were 335.17 for frontend, 172.76 for frontend-proxy, 84.92 for checkout, 0 for payment, accounting and cart, and ~1.03 each for ad, recommendation and fraud-detection.

ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config contains flag 'paymentFailure' with description 'Fail payment service charge requests n%', state ENABLED, defaultVariant '100%' (variants 10%=0.1, 100%=1, 25%=0.25, 50%=0.5, 75%=0.75, 90%=0.95, off=0), i.e. a failure rate that is not off/zero.

The same ConfigMap contains flag 'paymentUnreachable' with description 'Payment service is unavailable', state ENABLED, defaultVariant 'on' (variants off=false, on=true), i.e. switched on rather than off.

All other flags in flagd-config (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) have defaultVariant 'off'.

The payment Deployment is at deployment.kubernetes.io/revision 2 with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment; its new ReplicaSet payment-79d86bf97f was created 2026-11-18T00:14:51Z and its pod template carries the annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-18T00:14:51Z, while the previous ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 (revision 1) has the same image, the same env list and no restartedAt annotation.

Kubernetes events for the payment rollout: Deployment payment 'Scaled up replica set payment-79d86bf97f from 0 to 1' at 00:14:51, Pod payment-79d86bf97f-9pm9t Scheduled 00:14:51 and its container Created 00:14:54 / Started 00:14:55, Pod payment-55766d76b9-5frt4 'Stopping container payment' at 00:14:56 and ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 'Deleted pod: payment-55766d76b9-5frt4' at 00:14:56, Deployment 'Scaled down replica set payment-55766d76b9 from 1 to 0' at 00:14:56.

The replacement pod payment-79d86bf97f-9pm9t is Running with restartCount 0 and startTime 2026-11-18T00:14:51Z; frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-b9w85 and frontend-675fd7b5c5-f44st are also Running with restartCount 0 and startTimes 23:42:55Z / 23:42:57Z.

Between 00:14:30 and 00:16:30 the new payment container's log contained exactly one line, 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' at 2026-11-18T00:16:12.791Z (704 further lines fall after that window), so no charge activity was logged in that interval.

payment's own spans show STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 0 for span names 'charge', 'grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge', 'GET', 'dns.lookup' and 'tcp.connect' at every sample between 00:15 and 00:36, while its Charge spans continued at ~270-347 per 10m (STATUS_CODE_UNSET).
payment's only error-like log line in 00:13-00:30 (excluding 'Charge request received') is '14 UNAVAILABLE: Connection dropped' at 2026-11-18T00:17:08.851Z.

Deployments frontend, checkout and payment all define FLAGD_HOST=flagd and FLAGD_PORT=8013 (checkout also PAYMENT_ADDR=payment:8080), and the flagd Deployment mounts ConfigMap flagd-config as read-only volume config-ro at /etc/flagd, so these services can receive flags whose values are defined in flagd-config.

Namespace otel-demo contains only four ConfigMaps (flagd-config, kube-root-ca.crt, otel-collector, product-catalog-products), so flagd-config is the only fault-injection configuration holder seen in that namespace.

frontend-proxy's own access log contains a 503 with response detail 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' for 'GET /api/recommendations?productIds=OLJCESPC7Z' at 2026-11-18T00:25:23.761Z, the upstream being frontend.

Leading candidate for root cause: ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config, which holds the enabled payment fault flags paymentFailure='100%' and paymentUnreachable='on' naming the payment service, while payment is the workload that was restarted at 00:14:51 with an unchanged pod template and whose downstream callers (checkout's PaymentService/Charge, frontend /api/checkout, frontend-proxy ingress/router frontend egress) failed; the restart is the mechanism and the checkout-path errors the consequence. No other object was seen applying a change or fault to payment.

payment itself shows no failure evidence: zero STATUS_CODE_ERROR on its Charge spans throughout the window, charge traffic in the normal ~270-350 per 10m range with 2.1.3-payment logs showing 'Charge request received' repeatedly after 00:16:12, while both payment flags are still 'on' in the ConfigMap read at 00:38 and frontend-proxy error spans had returned to ~3.2-3.5 per 10m by the windows ending 00:36-00:37.

The error burst coincides with the payment pod's own restart gap rather than with a payment-returned error: old pod payment-55766d76b9-5frt4 was stopped at 00:14:56, the new container started at 00:14:55 but logged no charge traffic until its gRPC server started at 00:16:12.791, and it was checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge that carried the errors (42-52 per 10m) while payment's server spans stayed error-free.

Unresolved alternative: the checkout-path errors are fully explained by payment being unavailable during its 00:14:51-00:16:12 restart (checkout client calls to payment:8080 failing), with the injected paymentFailure/paymentUnreachable flags never actually taking effect; the evidence cannot separate this from the flag-based explanation because the declared fault was not observed firing and the time of the flag change is unknown.

Rejected: frontend-proxy pod failure/restart as the cause. frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-b9w85 is Running with restartCount 0 and startTime 23:42:55Z, and its errors are its own 'ingress' server spans paired 1:1 with 'router frontend egress' client spans whose upstream is frontend, i.e. errors propagated from its upstream rather than originating in the proxy process.

Rejected: a frontend pod/deployment restart as the cause. Pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-f44st is Running with restartCount 0 and startTime 23:42:57Z (unchanged through the incident), and the frontend Deployment is still at revision 1 with only one ReplicaSet, so its error spans on /api/checkout reflect the failed checkout->payment calls rather than a local restart.

Advise a human to read the flagd-config values in effect for paymentFailure and paymentUnreachable and reset them to 'off' if the fault injection was not intended, then confirm the served values via flagd; also audit who/what applied kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-18T00:14:51Z to Deployment otel-demo/payment, which is the only observed change around the alert onset.

gaps: No change-history integration is available, so when the flagd-config values were changed and what/who triggered the kubectl rollout restart of Deployment payment at 00:14:51 cannot be established.

The declared fault was never observed firing: no failed charge returned by payment and no error log from payment attributing failures to paymentFailure/paymentUnreachable, so the causal link from those flag values to the observed checkout errors is unverified.

The RequestErrorRate alert rule definition is not visible: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate and with type=alert both returned no data, so the alert's expression and the reported current value 0.01111111111111111 could not be reproduced or checked against the metrics.

app_payment_transactions_total returned no series, and get_label_values for rpc_grpc_status_code/rpc_method on rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name=...} and get_all_labels for http_server_request_duration_seconds_count returned nothing in 00:10-00:37:42, so payment transaction success/failure ratios and gRPC status codes (e.g. UNAVAILABLE 14) could not be observed directly.

No span-level error detail was obtainable: Jaeger's retained sample covered only ~00:06 (the read slice showed only http.status_code=200 spans), traces_search for checkout and frontend in 00:14-00:20 returned no traces, and traces_search_by_tags with error=true and otel.status_code="ERROR" matched nothing, so exact error messages on the failing spans are unknown.

Logs from the frontend container and from the flagd/flagd-ui/init-config containers returned no lines for the queried windows, and the previous (terminated) payment container's logs are unavailable, so the old payment pod's shutdown behaviour and the frontend's error text remain unknown.
The cronjobs query failed with SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so a scheduled job that could flip feature flags or restart payment could not be ruled out.

Exact onset timing is uncertain: 1-minute-resolution increase queries returned zeros/sparse points, so the error burst is bounded only to roughly 00:14-00:19 by 10-minute sliding windows, and metric timestamps lag the pod-event and log timestamps.
next_steps: Read the flagd configuration state (paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable) for the incident window from a change-history or flagd audit source that was not available in this Run.
Confirm with flagd evaluation telemetry or a test charge whether payment actually returned injected failures between 00:14 and 00:19, to decide between the flag-based and restart-based explanations.
Review cluster audit logs for the kubectl rollout restart of Deployment otel-demo/payment at 2026-11-18T00:14:51Z and for edits to ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config.
